description:
List the LLM subscriptions and keys YOUR company can use right now, each with how
to call it (`models[].call_as`) and whether it is usable. Takes no brand argument: your company
comes from your credential.

If your company is connected to other companies, the answer also carries a top-level
`connected` array: the keys they share with you. Each row has integration_id, owner_brand_id,
owner_name, provider, key_label, health_status, plan_name, price_usd_month, display_email and
`use_only: true` — nothing else. Use only: you can use a connected company's key, never change
it. Any change you attempt answers 404. A key its owner keeps private is not listed. `connected`
is absent when your company is in no group.

A lease (`lanes` contains "lease") can also be served on a connected company's login when that
company shares it; your own logins come first.

To change who your company is connected to, ask a human admin: connecting, disconnecting and
pairing are done in the dashboard and no tool can do them.

consumer.description: For lease subscriptions, the consumer id you would lease as (e.g. opvs_runner:env_<uuid>), so the lease answer is about your case.

include_unconfigured.description: Also list catalog models never marked configured (default false).

name: gate_subscriptions
